whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Basant Vihar,

I noticed your landmark restaurant has built an incredible 4.1★ reputation with over 5,000 reviews in Maurya Lok Complex, Patna, but lacked a mobile-friendly digital menu and direct WhatsApp ordering page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp food ordering, special thali/menu showcase, aur instant table reservation integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/basantvihar

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine Basant Vihar ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? It’s designed specifically for your Maurya Lok location with mobile menu browsing and WhatsApp reservations. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
